decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's software and network security capabilities, allowing the firm to assimilate and improve it.
Mobile and PDF integration align with existing programming skills, though digital signature technology requires some additional PKI knowledge.
Architecture and security consulting draw closely on the firm's core expertise, making early results readily interpretable.
Email-to-app automation is within the firm's software integration knowledge and can be enhanced through internal development.
Hardware token production and embedded security are distant from a software consultancy's knowledge base, limiting the firm's ability to learn and improve the product.
Payment compliance software builds on security consulting, though it requires acquiring specific payments regulation knowledge that the firm can develop through cooperation.
